title: Discovery Ranch
excerpt: An Ascent Companies residential treatment program for boys in Mapleton, Utah, opened in 2005, with a girls campus in Cedar City since 2013. Survivors describe a punitive merit system, censored family contact and peer sexual abuse that staff failed to prevent; 17-year-old Biruk Silvers died by suicide there in November 2024.

meta.facility_address_2: 4928 N 4500 W, Cedar City, UT 84721 (Discovery Ranch South, the girls campus, since 2013)
meta.founders: Ascent Companies (Steven Nadauld, owner); Brent Hall reported by survivors to have run the program
meta.parent_company: Ascent Companies (Ascent OPCO, LLC), Enterprise, Utah
meta.staff_transfers: Clint Dorny (executive director) began in admissions at Provo Canyon School; Dave Blackwell (therapist) and Brent Hall also came from Provo Canyon School
meta.staff_transfers_2: Leslie Glies (residential director) moved to RedCliff Ascent; Andrea Burgess led RedCliff Ascent before Discovery Ranch for Girls
meta.staff_transfers_3: Jack Hinman (clinical director, girls campus) went on to run Moonridge Academy and Kolob Canyon RTC; Tim Lowe came from Outback Therapeutic Expeditions
meta.trigger_warnings: Trigger warnings: sexual abuse, physical restraint, seclusion, self-harm, suicide, animal death
